meta.project: DesaKu — Website Layanan & Informasi Digital Kalurahan Pandowoharjo

product_overview: DesaKu adalah website layanan dan informasi digital desa yang memusatkan profil, berita, layanan administrasi, statistik, dan kanal pengaduan dalam satu portal publik. Sistem ini juga menyediakan panel admin untuk mengelola konten dan menindaklanjuti pengaduan warga secara terstruktur.
core_goals: Memudahkan warga mengakses profil desa, berita, dan informasi layanan administrasi kapan saja.
Menyediakan kanal pengaduan warga yang dapat dikirim dan dilacak statusnya.
Menampilkan statistik penduduk secara agregat untuk mendukung transparansi informasi publik.
Memberikan panel admin bagi perangkat desa untuk mengelola berita, layanan, profil, statistik, akun, dan pengaduan.
Memungkinkan pengelolaan mandiri oleh perangkat desa setelah serah terima.

features.name: Beranda publik dan navigasi responsif
features.description: Halaman beranda menampilkan sambutan, sorotan berita terbaru, dan akses cepat ke layanan serta pengaduan dengan tata letak yang menyesuaikan ukuran layar.
user_flows: Navigate to / -> Read the sambutan and latest news highlights -> Open the layanan page -> Return to the beranda -> Open the pengaduan page
Navigate to / on a desktop viewport -> Observe the wider responsive layout and enlarged content -> Use the navigation to move between public pages

features.name: Berita publik
features.description: Pengunjung dapat melihat daftar berita, memfilter kategori, membuka detail berita, dan kembali ke indeks berita.
user_flows: Navigate to /berita -> Browse published news cards -> Filter by a news category -> Open a news detail page -> Read the full article -> Return to /berita
Navigate to /berita -> Browse news cards -> Open a related news article from the detail rail -> Read the article -> Return to the news index

features.name: Direktori layanan warga
features.description: Pengunjung dapat mencari layanan, membaca persyaratan dan alur layanan, serta membuka tautan kontak cepat jika tersedia.
user_flows: Navigate to /layanan -> Search services by keyword -> Clear the search filter -> Select a service -> Read the requirements, process steps, and estimated time
Navigate to /layanan -> Open a service detail page -> Read the service information -> Open the WhatsApp contact link if available

features.name: Pengaduan publik dan pelacakan tiket
features.description: Warga dapat mengirim pengaduan melalui formulir, menerima kode tiket, lalu melacak status dan tanggapan pengaduan menggunakan kode tersebut.
user_flows: Navigate to /pengaduan -> Select a complaint category -> Enter complaint content -> Optionally enter a location and attachment URL -> Choose anonymous or identified submission -> Submit the form -> See the submitted ticket code on /pengaduan/terkirim
Navigate to /pengaduan/lacak -> Enter a ticket code -> Submit the tracking form -> See the current complaint status and public response
Navigate to /pengaduan -> Select anonymous submission -> Enter complaint content -> Submit the form -> See the ticket code on the confirmation page

features.name: Statistik penduduk publik
features.description: Halaman statistik menampilkan ringkasan kependudukan dan perbandingan kelompok usia dalam format yang mudah dibaca.
user_flows: Navigate to /statistik -> Read population KPI cards -> Compare age-group bars -> Read relative age-group values on desktop

features.name: Profil padukuhan publik
features.description: Halaman profil menyajikan sejarah, visi misi, struktur organisasi, dan peta lokasi dengan navigasi berbasis bagian.
user_flows: Navigate to /profil -> Jump to profile sections through anchor links -> Read the history and vision-mission content -> Review the organizational structure -> Interact with the embedded map -> Open the WhatsApp contact link

features.name: Admin login and role-based access
features.description: Admin dan superadmin dapat masuk ke panel dengan email dan kata sandi, lalu melihat menu sesuai peran mereka.
user_flows: Navigate to /admin/masuk -> Fill email and password -> Submit login form -> See the admin dashboard
Navigate to /admin/masuk -> Fill email and password with invalid credentials -> Submit login form -> See a validation error
Navigate to /admin -> Sign out from the sidebar -> See the login page
Navigate to /admin as an admin account -> Navigate allowed sidebar items -> See locked superadmin-only menu items

features.name: Admin dashboard
features.description: Dashboard admin menampilkan ringkasan konten dan pengaduan serta menyediakan akses cepat ke tugas pengelolaan.
user_flows: Navigate to /admin -> Read dashboard KPI cards -> Open recent complaints -> Open quick actions -> Start writing a news article

features.name: Manajemen berita admin
features.description: Admin dapat membuat, menyunting, menyimpan sebagai draf, menerbitkan, dan menghapus berita.
user_flows: Navigate to /admin/berita/baru -> Create a news article -> Save the article as a draft -> See the draft in the admin list
Navigate to /admin/berita -> Open a draft news item -> Publish the article -> See it appear on /berita and the homepage highlights
Navigate to /admin/berita -> Request delete confirmation -> Confirm deletion -> See the news item removed from admin and public listings

features.name: Manajemen layanan admin
features.description: Admin dapat menambah, menyunting, dan menghapus layanan administrasi beserta persyaratan dan langkah prosesnya.
user_flows: Navigate to /admin/layanan/baru -> Create a service -> Save the service -> See it appear on /layanan
Navigate to /admin/layanan -> Open a service page -> Edit service fields, requirements, and process steps -> Save the changes -> See the updated service detail publicly
Navigate to /admin/layanan -> Request service deletion -> Confirm deletion -> See the service removed from /layanan

features.name: Penanganan pengaduan admin
features.description: Admin dapat membuka detail pengaduan, memfilter daftar berdasarkan status, menulis tanggapan, dan memperbarui status pengaduan.
user_flows: Navigate to /admin/pengaduan -> Filter complaints by status -> Open complaint details -> Enter a response -> Update complaint status -> See the new status on /pengaduan/lacak
Navigate to /admin/pengaduan -> Open complaint details -> Update the complaint status to in progress -> Save the update -> See the tracking page reflect the new status

features.name: Manajemen statistik admin
features.description: Admin dapat mengelola angka statistik penduduk per tahun melalui penambahan, penyuntingan, dan penghapusan baris data.
user_flows: Navigate to /admin/statistik -> Switch the data year -> Edit values and ordering -> Save the changes -> See the updated figures on /statistik
Navigate to /admin/statistik -> Add a statistic row -> Save the row -> See the new data reflected publicly
Navigate to /admin/statistik -> Delete a statistic row -> Confirm deletion -> See the row removed from the public statistics page

features.name: Manajemen profil dan struktur organisasi admin
features.description: Admin dapat menyunting naskah profil desa, mengelola status draf, dan mengatur data perangkat desa.
user_flows: Navigate to /admin/profil -> Edit history and vision-mission text -> Save the changes -> See the content updated on /profil
Navigate to /admin/profil -> Add organization members -> Save the changes -> See the new member cards in the public profile structure
Navigate to /admin/profil -> Request member deletion -> Confirm deletion -> See the member removed from the public structure

features.name: Manajemen akun admin
features.description: Superadmin dapat mengelola akun admin, menonaktifkan atau menghapus akses, menyetel ulang sandi, dan menambahkan akun baru.
user_flows: Navigate to /admin/akun -> Edit account name, position, role, and active state -> Save the changes -> See the account updated in the list
Navigate to /admin/akun -> Add a new admin account -> Save the account -> See the new account in the list
Navigate to /admin/akun -> Reset another account password -> Save the new password -> Use the new password to sign in
Navigate to /admin/sandi -> Change the current account password -> Submit the form -> Sign in again with the new password
